title: ATCT-PH Phase 2B v0.1 — Attractor Flattening and Operational Boundary Degeneracy

scope.scientific_target: 自己復帰強度の低下に伴う operational causal boundary distinguishability の縮退
excluded_targets: soul existence, persistence, death, or transfer
scope.claim_ceiling: synthetic, access-relative, operational boundary-degeneracy claim only

model.equation: x_{t+1} = F(x_t) + kappa * R(x_t, K) + eta_t
model.eta: zero-mean Gaussian process noise with covariance frozen before Pilot
model.delta_T_role: analysis-window hyperparameter only; never treated as a physical state variable

access_class.A_P2B: predefined observations Y plus matched internal/external intervention families
access_class.I_out: amplitude/profile-matched interventions on preregistered outside-target channels
access_class.matching_rule: same profile, amplitude, duration, observation window, and paired noise namespace
access_class.target_label_randomization: inside/outside slot labels are permuted per seed before simulation and hidden from estimators

primary_endpoint.name: D_boundary(kappa)
primary_endpoint.interpretation: operational boundary distinguishability under A_P2B; not latent-boundary identity
primary_endpoint.trajectory_signature: fixed post-intervention multivariate trajectory segment after baseline subtraction and preregistered scale normalization
primary_endpoint.normalization: ED_norm = ED / (ED + S_pool), where S_pool is the preregistered pooled within-cell pairwise-distance scale
primary_endpoint.aggregation: median ED_norm across matched intervention cells
primary_endpoint.formula: D_boundary(kappa) = median_{c in C} ED_norm(P_in^c(Y|kappa), P_out^c(Y|kappa))

primary_hypothesis.statement: For decreasing kappa, D_boundary does not increase beyond tolerance and shows a non-trivial endpoint reduction.
primary_hypothesis.failure_rule: any certified flattening condition with monotonicity violation > 0.02, or Delta_D < 0.10

secondary_extinction_endpoint.statement: Operational extinction is separate from trend support.
secondary_extinction_endpoint.criterion: D_boundary(kappa_min) <= epsilon_B with preregistered uncertainty upper bound <= epsilon_B
secondary_extinction_endpoint.firewall: extinction under A_P2B does not imply absolute disappearance of causal influence outside A_P2B

independent_flattening_certificate.name: F_flat(kappa)
independent_flattening_certificate.primary_definition: median local restoring curvature of the effective return potential over a preregistered neighborhood of K
independent_flattening_certificate.formula: F_flat(kappa) = median_{x in N(K)} lambda_min(Hessian[U_0(x) + kappa U_K(x)])
independent_flattening_certificate.empirical_crosscheck: median return probability and median tau_return after matched off-K perturbations
independent_flattening_certificate.required_direction: F_flat must decrease as kappa decreases
independent_flattening_certificate.failure_semantics: if this gate fails, no inference about boundary degeneration is allowed

counterworld_falsification.purpose: test whether flattening can occur without operational boundary degeneration within the preregistered admissible generator family
counterworld_falsification.falsification_pattern: F_flat decreases but D_boundary is preserved within tolerance
counterworld_falsification.formal_rule: if F_flat(0.0) <= 0.50*F_flat(1.0) AND D_boundary(0.0) >= D_boundary(1.0)-0.02, then H1_TREND is FALSIFIED for the registered claim scope
counterworld_falsification.anti_rescue_rule: do not retune estimator, intervention family, normalization, or thresholds after a valid CW1 hit

fisher_diagnostic.definition: g_kappa(theta) = E[(grad_theta log p_kappa(Y|do(I);theta))(grad_theta log p_kappa(Y|do(I);theta))^T]
fisher_diagnostic.theta: frozen observation-model parameter vector specified before implementation qualification
fisher_diagnostic.expectation: over the preregistered intervention distribution and observation model
fisher_diagnostic.forbidden_inference: Fisher singularity or rank loss must not be interpreted as ego dissolution, consciousness loss, or soul dissolution

window_susceptibility.B_eff: operational boundary-size or boundary-score summary defined by the implementation contract
window_susceptibility.firewall: peaks are critical-window candidates, not physical phase transitions

uncertainty_and_statistics.paired_design: matched in/out interventions share seed-specific nuisance draws
uncertainty_and_statistics.primary_uncertainty: seed bootstrap confidence interval with algorithm frozen before Pilot
uncertainty_and_statistics.multiple_testing: not applicable to the single primary H1 gate; all diagnostics are explicitly secondary

gates.name: SPEC_FREEZE
gates.pass: all formulas, kappa grid, access class, estimator, thresholds, seed namespaces, and counterworld rules are immutable before Pilot

gates.name: DYNAMIC_RANGE
gates.pass: interventions produce estimable non-saturated responses across the registered kappa grid

gates.name: INTERVENTION_MATCHING
gates.pass: I_in and I_out satisfy frozen amplitude/profile/energy matching tolerances

gates.name: NULL_CALIBRATION
gates.pass: a no-boundary-difference null does not produce a spurious D_boundary trend beyond delta_D

gates.name: COUNTERWORLD
gates.pass_or_stop: a valid CW1 hit falsifies H1 and stops support claims; failure to construct CW1 is not evidence of universality

gates.name: ORACLE_CLONE_FIREWALL
gates.pass: an access-equivalent latent implementation remains explicitly non-identifiable; boundary-degeneration detection must not be upgraded to latent-mechanism identity

claim_firewall: DeltaT is an analysis parameter, not a death-state variable
synthetic success != biological or neural validity
boundary degeneration detected != latent boundary mechanism identified
next_step_after_freeze: implement only the narrow Pilot/qualification layer; do not generate Confirmatory data until every mandatory qualification gate passes and a separate confirmatory freeze is created
